heading.en: Store a whole list in one go

hook.en: A text file stores only strings. What if you want to save a list like [1, "Asha", 30000] and get back a list, not text? pickle does that.
hook.kn: ಪಠ್ಯ ಕಡತ ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. [1, "Asha", 30000] ಎಂಬ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿಯೇ ಪಡೆಯಲು pickle ಬಳಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

objectives.en: Read all records from a binary file

narration.en: A text file stores only strings. What if you want to save a list like [1, "Asha", 30000] and get back a list, not text? pickle does that.
narration.kn: ಪಠ್ಯ ಕಡತ ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. [1, "Asha", 30000] ಎಂಬ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿಯೇ ಪಡೆಯಲು pickle ಬಳಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

body.en: The pickle module converts a Python object (list, dictionary, tuple…) into a byte stream that can be stored in a binary file; this is pickling or serialization. Converting the byte stream back into the same object is unpickling or deserialization. dump(data_object, file_object) writes an object to a file opened in binary write mode, and load(file_object) reads the next object from a file opened in binary read mode.

points.en: pickle.dump(obj, f) with f opened in 'wb' or 'ab'
obj = pickle.load(f) with f opened in 'rb'
load() raises EOFError at the end of the file

narration.en: The pickle module converts a Python object (list, dictionary, tuple…) into a byte stream that can be stored in a binary file; this is pickling or serialization. Converting the byte stream back into the same object is unpickling or deserialization. dump(data_object, file_object) writes an object to a file opened in binary write mode, and load(file_object) reads the next object from a file opened in binary read mode.
narration.kn: pickle ಮಾಡ್ಯೂಲ್ ಪೈಥಾನ್ ಆಬ್ಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಅನ್ನು ಬೈಟ್ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್ ಆಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ (ಸೀರಿಯಲೈಸೇಶನ್). ಮತ್ತೆ ಆಬ್ಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಆಗಿ ಪಡೆಯುವುದು ಡೀಸೀರಿಯಲೈಸೇಶನ್. dump() ಬರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, load() ಓದುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: Store two employee records in a binary file and display them. Give the exact output.

narration.en: Each dump writes one record. The loop keeps loading until load() raises EOFError, which we catch to stop cleanly.
Roll-call quiz. When your roll number is called, give your answer.
narration.kn: ಹಾಜರಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಾಜರಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಹೇಳಿ.

narration.en: CBSE pattern: assertion–reason and case-based questions. Read the case carefully before you answer.
Now two board and CUET pattern questions. Try them on your own before we discuss.

points.en: Pickling converts an object to a byte stream; unpickling converts it back.
points.kn: ಪಿಕ್ಲಿಂಗ್: ಆಬ್ಜೆಕ್ಟ್ → ಬೈಟ್ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್; ಅನ್‌ಪಿಕ್ಲಿಂಗ್: ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ.

points.en: dump() needs a file opened in 'wb' or 'ab'; load() needs 'rb'.
Read all objects in a loop and stop on EOFError.

homework.en: Write a program to store student records [roll, name, marks] with pickle and display those who scored above 80.

narration.en: Recap. Pickling converts an object to a byte stream; unpickling converts it back. dump() needs a file opened in 'wb' or 'ab'; load() needs 'rb'. Read all objects in a loop and stop on EOFError.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪಿಕ್ಲಿಂಗ್: ಆಬ್ಜೆಕ್ಟ್ → ಬೈಟ್ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್; ಅನ್‌ಪಿಕ್ಲಿಂಗ್: ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ. dump() ಗೆ 'wb' ಅಥವಾ 'ab'; load() ಗೆ 'rb'. ಲೂಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಓದಿ, EOFError ಬಂದಾಗ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ.
